question: ________ is the highest peak in the Eastern Ghats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Mahendragiri **is the highest peak in the** Eastern Ghats mountain range.**
 
• It is located in the Indian state of Odisha and has an elevation of** 1,501 meters (4,925 feet) above sea level.**
 
• Mahendragiri is also considered a sacred site in Hindu mythology and is believed to be the place where Lord Parashurama, a Hindu deity, performed penance.
 
• The mountain is also known for its beautiful natural surroundings and is a popular trekking destination for adventure enthusiasts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** The Eastern Ghats is a mountain range that runs parallel to the eastern coast of India, stretching over 1,750 kilometers (1,087 miles) from West Bengal in the north to Tamil Nadu in the south.**
 
• The range is lower in elevation compared to the Western Ghats and has an average height of around 600 meters (1,969 feet) above sea level, with some peaks reaching up to **1,500 meters (4,921 feet).**
 
• The Eastern Ghats is a complex and diverse mountain range, consisting of **several hills, plateaus, valleys, and forests, with a variety of flora and fauna.**
 
• The range is home to many tribal communities, and several rivers originate from the Eastern Ghats.
 
• The Eastern Ghats is an important region for biodiversity conservation, with several protected areas and wildlife reserves, such as the** Simlipal National Park and Biosphere Reserve in Odisha, the Papikonda Wildlife Sanctuary in Andhra Pradesh, and the Kambalakonda Wildlife Sanctuary in Visakhapatnam.**
